answers.project_description: A control systems simulator for ball-on-table balancing with Kalman filtering and OpenGL rendering
answers.problem_statement: Provides an educational tool for learning control theory, state estimation, and real-time systems
answers.target_users: Developers building simulation and visualization tools
key_goals: Accurate physics simulation with minimal computational overhead
Visual tool to real-time visualize simulations and effect of controllers
An environment to develop and test new control theory methods, filters, observers and numerical methods
answers.voice_and_tone: Concise and direct but also feisty and sarcastic
answers.deployment: Desktop (native builds for Windows/Linux/macOS) + Web (via Emscripten/WebAssembly)
answers.tdd_strictness: Flexible - tests recommended for complex logic
answers.existing_conventions: No, generate fresh C++ style guide
